name: PNCA Pre-College summer art and design programs
org: Pacific Northwest College of Art (PNCA) at Willamette University, Community Education
what_you_do: 2 week Intensives and 1 week Studios. You draw, paint, animate and illustrate with PNCA teachers and artists. You build portfolio work. You meet admissions staff for a portfolio review.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 18 who have finished at least one year of high school.
pay_detail: Summer 2027 tuition includes materials. Intensive: $2,400 ($2,160 with early registration). Studio: $1,200 ($1,080 with early registration). Limited need-based scholarships and payment plans are available.
duration: Intensives are 2 weeks and Studios are 1 week, 9 am to 4:30 pm Monday to Friday. 2027 sessions run July 12 to Aug 6.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications are taken on a rolling basis until programs are full, as of Nov 4, 2026. Early application Mar 28, 2027; early registration Apr 11, 2027; application deadline May 2, 2027; registration deadline June 6, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. If you are accepted, you get an email with a link to register and pay. Applications are taken until programs are full.
notes: The page does not list scholarship amounts.
